result.title: RelateGS: Reliable Semantic and Relational Evidence for 3D Scene Understanding with Gaussian Splatting
result.summary: Language-aware 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has advanced language-driven 3D scene understanding by incorporating semantic and relational cues into reconstructed scenes. However, relation-aware grounding depends not only on representing such information, but also on whether the underlying scene-side evidence is reliable and sufficient. Multi-view semantic aggregation can incorporate weak observations, while object relations can remain under-observed along the available camera trajectory, leading to ambiguous evidence for target disambiguation. We present RelateGS, a structured language-aware Gaussian representation that selectively refines semantic and relational evidence for 3D visual grounding. RelateGS suppresses unreliable observations during semantic feature uplifting and consolidates multi-view object observations into a persistent 3D graph. The graph further identifies under-observed object relations and guides targeted re-querying of informative existing frames to complement their evidence. Experiments on Sr3D+ and Nr3D demonstrate competitive 3D grounding performance, improving the previous best by 7.9 and 1.7 percentage points at Acc@0.25, respectively.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 RelateGS，一种语言感知的 3DGS 表示：在语义特征提升阶段抑制不可靠观测，把多视角物体观测整合为持久 3D 图，并据此找出观测不足的物体关系、定向重查询已有帧补充证据，在 Sr3D+ 与 Nr3D 上提升 3D  grounding 指标。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「关系证据是否充分」的显式判断与针对性重查询已有帧，可能与 VLM 推理中 LOOK 阶段的视觉证据筛选及何时补充证据相关；但该工作面向 3D grounding、未涉及 latent 推理状态，迁移可行性需核查。
